prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-bleed cinematic opening artwork for The Last Dragonrider, a medieval fantasy RPG. Create a richly detailed hand-painted storybook fantasy illustration, landscape 1536x1024, warm natural colors, visible fine brushwork, believable anatomy and clear silhouettes. Scene: Emberfell before Wingfall. Exactly SEVEN adult dragonriders on exactly SEVEN distinct adult dragons, soaring together above peaceful green farmland, an old stone bridge, small timber medieval villages and distant mountains. Organize the seven pairs clearly with ample space between each: three near, four farther behind; all seven riders visibly seated at base of their dragon's neck; do not add any background dragons. Various natural scale colors, two horns per dragon, leathery wings. A few people travel on the road below. Magnificent hopeful sunrise with golden cloud edges, verdant fields. Central 75% contains the seven recognizable dragon silhouettes; spacious sky, nuanced rich painted atmosphere. This is a historical tableau, no Corin, no baby Aurelius, no modern objects. No text, labels, lettering, frames, panels, collage, border or watermark. No fire or battle.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-bleed cinematic opening artwork for The Last Dragonrider. Landscape 1536x1024. Fine hand-painted fantasy storybook illustration, rich brushwork, coherent medieval armor, readable shapes. Depict Wingfall, the betrayal of the dragonriders fifty years before the game. An ominous mounted dragonrider with a dark beard, green cloak and engraved steel armor turns against the other riders amid roiling storm clouds over a medieval valley. He is shown from rear three-quarter view in the right foreground, dragon banking sharply toward opposing rider silhouettes farther left. One enormous sweep of dragon wings and a controlled diagonal streak of fire divide the sky; the other riders wheel away through smoky clouds. Keep the event evocative, no explicit deaths, corpses, wounds or blood; do not depict the fate of the six, a named battle site, a magical cause or particular weapon. Mood of trust shattered, grief and alarm, charcoal gray storm, ember red fire and muted gold rim light. Characters and dragon anatomy distinct, no extra limbs. Important scene framed in central 75%. No text, border, logos, watermark or panels.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: full-bleed cinematic opening artwork for The Last Dragonrider. Landscape 1536x1024, detailed hand-painted fantasy storybook illustration with restrained brushwork, not photorealistic or pixel art. Emberfell during the fifty years after Wingfall. A once busy medieval stone road and old mile marker now overgrown, winding from abandoned rider temple ruins on a wooded hillside toward a distant closed village gate. A weathered stone DRAGON statue stands near the temple, vines covering empty stairs. No text, signs with lettering, captions, panels, border or watermark.
